header.status_line: Form is the NEW 6th Situate sub-engine (Decision 226 C1). It names the whole-utterance genre the engine had dropped despite descending from form criticism. On Mark 16 it is coded (1 engine-proposed row): genre_form='resurrection-narrative with appended commissioning-summary (burial → empty-tomb → resurrection appearances → Great Commission → ascension)', communicative_function DERIVED from the move-force profile (R1, audited PASS). Honest state: thin (1 record), text-grain (pericope-grain owed), same-family CRT (an optimistic floor).

what_it_is: Form reads the WHOLE text and names its Gattung — the kind of utterance it is (a resurrection-narrative, a law, a hymn, a lament, a commissioning) and how a community is meant to receive it. Four fields: genre_form (the kind), communicative_function (what it DOES — derived from the aggregate of the move-level forces Decompose already coded), implied_addressee (whom it addresses), and performance_institutional_setting (the form-critical Sitz im Leben where it is performed).
why_it_matters: Genre is the horizon of expectation a hearer brings — the same sentence means differently in a law than in a hymn. Form is the classical EVIDENCE for the Sitz the engine already codes: form criticism read a text's life-setting off its genre. It is also where an absence shows: a genre a tradition never produces, an addressee it never speaks to, is a negative-space fact. And by DERIVING communicative_function from the move-force aggregate rather than re-asserting it, Form ties the whole-utterance read to the coded moves — the derivation is auditable, not asserted.

how_it_works.you_give_it: the whole (verbatim) text + its already-coded moves (Decompose's operation_force).
how_it_works.the_method_does: aggregates the move-level forces into a normalized force_profile (the mechanical R1 warrant), then names the four Form fields — with communicative_function required to be consistent with the dominant forces in that profile. Force is never re-coded; it is read.
how_it_works.you_get_back: one Form row per unit: genre + communicative-function + addressee + setting, with the force_profile stored beside it so the derivation is visible, and the C4/R7 honesty tag.

pipeline_context.note: sibling terms glossed so the card stands alone.
pipeline_context.move: one small action a text makes (agent does an operation to something) — the unit Decompose produces.
pipeline_context.operation_force: the speech-act force of a single move (assert / command / question / promise / perform / express) — coded by Decompose. Form AGGREGATES these; it does not re-code them.
pipeline_context.Decompose: the parallel node that breaks the passage into moves + codes each move's force. Form reads its output.
pipeline_context.Situate: the parent node: attaches context to the text; Form is its whole-utterance genre aspect.
pipeline_context.Gattung: form-critical term for a text's genre/form-type (Gunkel) — the kind of utterance + its typical setting.
pipeline_context.Sitz im Leben: the life-setting of a genre (where such an utterance is performed) — Form names it as performance_institutional_setting.
pipeline_context.R1: the rule that keeps Form and Decompose complementary: communicative_function is DERIVED from the aggregate of move-forces (whole-utterance grain), never a restatement of the per-move force.
pipeline_context.force_profile: the normalized {force: proportion} distribution for a unit's moves — the visible warrant for communicative_function.
pipeline_context.the foundation honesty tag: evidence_basis + certainty (C4/R7) — how the form is known + how confident, carried on every Situate coding.
pipeline_context.PI: the principal investigator (the researcher) — who locks methodology calls.

how_we_grade_it.Fidelity: mechanical + Form-specific: (a) every field the card names maps to a real source_form column; (b) the R1 audit — the stored force_profile_json EQUALS a fresh move-force aggregate recomputed from source_move, proving communicative_function was derived, not re-coded.
how_we_grade_it.Cold Read: self-sufficiency: a blind reader with no project context judges whether the card explains itself.
how_we_grade_it.vs-Wild: does the Form coding beat a naive reader given only the text + 'what genre is this, and what does it do?' — measured by the Form 3-model CRT (agreement across models is the reliability FLOOR).
how_we_grade_it.result_categories: INCOMPLETE (not run) / FAIL (run, lost) / PARTIAL / PASS.
how_we_grade_it.scripts: Fidelity = the R1 audit computed inside build_form_subengine_drawer_data_s168.py; Cold Read = run_cold_read.py; vs-Wild = the Form 3-model CRT (build_form_3crt_s168_sample.py + form_3crt_compare_s168.py). Every verdict is stored in the card_check table and rendered as the pills above — never hardcoded (method-principles.html: no magic hand). Exact commands are in the research view below.

the_method_clean.note: Form is ONE aspect, FOUR open/emergent fields, coded at unit grain. It introduces NO new closed vocabulary (§2.1 — genre is discovered, not picked from a fixed list); the only CLOSED fields are the cross-cutting foundation columns (evidence_basis / certainty / scope_level), whose sets render LIVE from situate_foundation_vocab. communicative_function is the one constrained field: OPEN in wording but required to fit the force_profile (R1).

the_method_clean.r1_rule: communicative_function is DERIVED from / references the aggregate of Decompose's move-level operation_force: mostly command+promise → covenant/law; mostly praise/bless → hymn; mostly lament → lament; mostly assert → narrative/exposition. The force_profile_json stores that aggregate so the derivation is VISIBLE and auditable (§2.8). Form AGGREGATES force; it never re-codes what Decompose already coded — Fidelity's R1 audit enforces this mechanically.
the_method_clean.live_vocab_rule: Form's four fields are OPEN, so there is no vocab table to render; the CLOSED foundation columns render their sets LIVE from situate_foundation_vocab (never hardcoded, §2.16).

texts.axis: language axis (Koine Greek — same text, different language)
texts.genre_form: resurrection-narrative with embedded commissioning, rendered in a critically-stratified manuscript text: (a) empty-tomb angelophany (16:1–8, unbracketed core), (b) a Shorter Ending in ⟦⟧ that names its content as τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἄφθαρτον κήρυγμα τῆς αἰωνίου σωτηρίας, and (c) a Longer Ending likewise ⟦⟧-bracketed comprising appearance-summary, rebuke, commissioning-speech, ascension-report, and mission-confirmation; the double-bracket apparatus renders the three-layer form-history structurally visible within this very document
texts.communicative_function: kerygmatic testimony-narration: the assert-dominant profile (0.679) drives sequential witness-report — named women, graded disbelief across three audiences, named appearances — building an evidentiary chain for the resurrection claim; promise (0.179) delivers eschatological stakes (σωθήσεται / κατακριθήσεται; sign-catalog as guarantee); command (0.089) deploys the hearer into mission (κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει); the profile as a whole executes kerygma: assertion underwrites the claim, promise names its weight, command activates the receiver — narration is the vehicle, proclamation is the act

texts.axis: genre/content axis (Daodejing ch.1 — accretive, authorless, apophatic)
texts.genre_form: cosmogonic philosophical prologue / aphoristic wisdom-teaching: a programmatic opening zhāng (章) of a canonical jīng (經) that grounds the entire subsequent work by positing the nature of the Tao before it can be spoken; the form fuses cosmogonic assertion (Originator / Mother of all things), self-referential paradox (naming the unnameable as its first act), embedded wisdom-verse (the desire/Mystery quatrain), and synthesizing aphorism (the Mystery as gate)
texts.communicative_function: cosmogonic-aphoristic exposition with performative enactment: the dominant assert-force (0.727) lays ontological ground — the Tao as prior to name, as source of heaven-and-earth, as the Mystery beneath all differentiation; crucially the perform force (0.091) is not decorative but structural — the opening sentence enacts what it asserts, naming the Tao while declaring naming insufficient, making the utterance itself an instance of the limit it describes; command and promise (each 0.091) then gate the reader: desirelessness opens depth, desire forecloses it; the whole does not merely describe but initiates a mode of receptivity

where_saved.plain: Form rows save to source_form, keyed by source_key + run_tag (one row per unit per run). The force_profile_json column carries the R1 warrant; the foundation columns (evidence_basis / certainty / scope_level / scope_id / alternative_hypothesis) carry the honesty tag + grain. The move-force it aggregates lives in source_move.operation_force (Decompose's store) — Form references, never copies.

honest_limits: TEXT-GRAIN FIRST PASS. Form is coded at scope_level='text' (one row for the whole source_key). The pericope grain (C8 = the pericope/unit-grain candidate locked in the Situate-engine spec, Decision 226) — the natural Form unit — is OWED: source_move has no native pericope column, so a text with MULTIPLE Gattungen collapses into one row. Mark 16 is the exact case: 16:1-8 (empty-tomb narrative, ends in fear/silence) vs 16:9-20 (the Longer Ending — appearances + commissioning) are arguably different forms; the current single row names the composite and flags the split in alternative_hypothesis. Pericope-grain Form needs the chunker (scripts/pipeline/chunk_batch_auto_detect.py — the corpus CHUNK stage) to wire its native sub-divisions to moves (a follow-up build phase, Stage 1C of the Situate engine).

THIN — 1 engine-proposed record for Mark 16 (coding_status=engine-proposed). A definition + one worked row, not a scaled or cold-confirmed run. The Form 3-model CRT (S168) measures reliability (the vs-Wild pill = PARTIAL, the same-family floor); the Cold Read has run 2026-08-11 (opus, cold) — PARTIAL.

SAME-FAMILY CRT FLOOR (§2.14). The reliability numbers come from Claude-only models (opus/sonnet/haiku), so agreement is OPTIMISTIC — a floor, not the ceiling. A heterogeneous panel (Claude + GPT + Gemini + a human gold slice) is the PI-gated next step that bounds the same-family optimism.

communicative_function IS CONSTRAINED, NOT MECHANICAL. The force_profile is computed mechanically, but the coder still NAMES communicative_function (informed by the profile). The R1 audit verifies the profile is real (not re-coded force); it does not (and cannot) verify the naming is the uniquely-correct label — that is the CRT's and vs-Wild's job.

per_text.convergence_note: All three coders identify the same tripartite Gattung — empty-tomb angelophany (16:1–8) as undisputed core, plus Shorter and Longer Endings visible through the ⟦⟧ apparatus — and all three name the composite communicative act as kerygmatic testimony-narration (assert-dominant proclamation of the resurrection, with secondary promise underwriting eschatological stakes and command issuing the missional mandate).

All three coders identify the same composite Gattung — burial-report → empty-tomb angelophany (16:1–8) → appearance-and-commissioning appendix (16:9–20) — and unanimously name the communicative act as assert-dominant kerygmatic proclamation that moves from testimony to missional summons, with promise and command as secondary forces.

All three coders identify the same Gattung — cosmogonic aphoristic prologue of a canonical jīng, paradox-structured to establish the limits of language before any further teaching — and unanimously describe the communicative act as assert-dominant apophatic wisdom-assertion in which perform enacts the naming-limit structurally, command prescribes desirelessness as epistemic method, and promise gates what that disposition yields.
